lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular maxima are arranged in approximately 6-7 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spatial distribution follows a grid-like topology where horizontal distance between centroids is roughly consistent across the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs to create defined grid nodes, most prominent in the transition zone between the head and the primary flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity reflection on the dorsal-facing edge and high-contrast shadowing on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregularly shaped pale/depigmented patch is visible on the upper dorsal-lateral surface, posterior to the head region, exhibiting a lack of standard spot-patterning contrast.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) visible along the ventral margin and trailing the pectoral fin.
